substeps.caption: Tray O, the atomized lots: 377 labelled jars (195 x 30 mL, 128 x 60 mL, 54 x 125 mL). Every run gets a six-character ID (DAL #157: jz31op, 8rthq2, c3k0n5, ...).
Each run's sieve fractions go in jars of their own: < 63 um for LPBF, 63-106, 106-150, 150-250 and > 250 um.
Clear glass, a black cap, a white label with the run and fraction.
Tinted for now (legend, top right): the < 63 um LPBF cut, and the other cuts of run jz31op.
Only a highlight, held for a few seconds...
...then back to plain glass and black caps.
The arm picks by seat: out/powder_store.json lists every jar, what is in it and whether the arm reaches it.
